short_description: Your computer's live CPU and RAM load on two graphs. Needs Glances on Mac, Windows or Linux; the installer sets it up.
description:
Live CPU and RAM load of your computer on two graphs: CPU on the left, RAM on the right, each with its current value. One column per sample; the graph holds from 18 seconds to 18 minutes.

**Setup.** Plug the bar in by USB and run on the computer:

- Mac or Linux, Terminal: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrlunev/busybar-host-load/main/install.sh | bash
- Windows, PowerShell: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrlunev/busybar-host-load/main/install.ps1 | iex

The installer sets up [Glances](https://nicolargo.github.io/glances/), starts it at every login and fills in the computer's address. After that the bar works over the cable or the same Wi-Fi.

**Controls:** Back closes the app.

**States:** SET ADDRESS, NO GLANCES. The back screen shows how to fix each.

**Settings:** update every 0.5 to 30 seconds.

**Privacy:** Glances serves only CPU and memory load, nothing about processes, disks or network, and sends nothing to the internet.
